title: A proposal that has 22 technicians hand-fill a 40-column sheet every morning to produce a report the telemetry already supports

planted.why: the proposal asks 22 technicians for 46 hours a week of hand-entered data that the 5-minute telemetry and the dashboard's stuck rule already provide, and nothing in it explains how a weekly report lowers complaints

proof.python:
t = open('proposal.md').read()
assert '25 minutes per technician per day' in t and 'every 5 minutes' in t and 'already shows a bike as' in t
